# ScatterChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders continuous numeric X/Y scatter plots with optional area-mapped bubble sizing and OLS linear trendlines.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ScatterChart()
new ScatterChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`BubbleFillOpacity`](#bubblefillopacity): Fill opacity for area-scaled bubbles (0 to 1).
- [`DefaultMarkerFill`](#defaultmarkerfill): Default fill mode of scatter markers (`solid` or `hollow`).
- [`DefaultMarkerRadius`](#defaultmarkerradius): Default radius of scatter point markers in points.
- [`DefaultMarkerShape`](#defaultmarkershape): Default geometric shape of scatter markers.
- [`MaxBubbleRadius`](#maxbubbleradius): Maximum bubble radius in points when `Size` values are provided.
- [`MinBubbleRadius`](#minbubbleradius): Minimum bubble radius in points when `Size` values are provided.
- [`ShowTrendline`](#showtrendline): Optional ordinary least-squares trendline per series (`none` or `linear`).
- [`ShowVerticalGridLines`](#showverticalgridlines): Whether to draw vertical gridlines along the continuous X axis.
- [`XReferences`](#xreferences): Optional reference lines and shaded bands on the horizontal X axis.
